title: Cassoni Studio
address: Levandivska St, 5а, Lviv, Lviv Oblast, Ukraine, 79025

user_reviews.Name: Arsen Horetskyy (Zorofell)
user_reviews.Description: Задоволений співпрацею! Все виконали чітко і якісно, окремо вдячний дизайнеру Дарині за консультацію та рекомендації!

user_reviews.Name: Настя Комарницька
user_reviews.Description:
Дякую Cassoni studio за якісне виготовлення та встановлення меблів!
Дуже задоволена співпрацею, якістю виробів та рівнем сервісу. Каркас міцний, добре зібраний, матрац комфортний і відповідає всім заявленим характеристикам.
Доставка та монтаж виконані вчасно та акуратно.Команда відповідальна та приємна у спілкуванні.Рекомендую дану фірму як надійного виробника та постачальника меблів.

user_reviews.Name: Анастасія Федотова
user_reviews.Description:
Співпрацювали з цією компанією навесні. Прочитали відгуки, подивилися роботи — ну, мало би бути все ідеально.
Приїхали до них в офіс, щоб підібрати матеріал і колір.
Все йшло чудово, ми дуже надихнулися цим процесом. І взагалі для нас це було важливо, бо ми тільки переїхали з хлопцем у будинок і створювали свій затишок.

Але як все було насправді?

Ми підписали договір з кінцевою датою до 15 червня, але нам сказали, що до 10–12 червня вже точно буде готово.
Спойлер: ми ледь добилися, щоб нам привезли кухню десь 27 червня.
Постійно переносили час і привезли кухню о 10 вечора (звісно, ніхто її не збирав у той самий день).

У процесі створення кухні до нас приїжджали 3 (!) рази переміряти стіни, техніку і так далі.
Одні й ті самі заміри робили, хоча нас запевняли, що команда — професіонали з багаторічним досвідом на ринку.

Коли вже встановлювали кухню, виявилося, що заміри неточні, бо майстри коригували висоту та інші деталі.
Нагадую: приїжджали 3 рази переміряти.

Після встановлення з’ясувалося, що забули фасад для посудомийки, і його доставили лише згодом.
Далі у нас зламалася сенсорна підсвітка під верхніми шафчиками.
Ми користувалися нею приблизно 3 рази.
І ми ледь добилися того, щоб до нас приїхали й замінили її.
Вона гарантійна, і заміна була зазначена в договорі (та й зламалась не з нашої вини).

Спочатку нас ігнорували, потім відповідали раз на тиждень або просто зникали.
Коли хлопець нарешті добився, щоб її замінили — знаєте, через скільки зламалася вже замінена? Приблизно через день.

І ось уже близько місяця ми чекаємо, поки зроблять повторну заміну.
Чи дійсно вони професіонали? Не можу відповісти на це питання.

Кухня гарна, все так, як ми й задумали в дизайні, колір чудовий — але такі значні деталі створюють дуже неприємні враження від усього процесу і команди.

Не рекомендую.

user_reviews.Description:

Я шокована 😫 Не рекомендую! Не обманюйте людей, а якщо навіть таке трапилось , вмійте повернути кошти за таке жахіття та зіпсований настрій!

І це дійсно так. І скажу чесно, аби вдовольнити мого чоловіка, потрібно дійсно мати найкращі квіти із усіх салонів навколо.

Простояли майже 2 тижні. І кожна! квітка розпустилася. А розпуск був величиною із долоню!

Вдячна цьому салону за таку красу і якість.

Ми прийдемо ще🧡

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexander Kryukov
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Купив букет квітів, сказали "що свіжий, квіти привезли сьогодні". Через дві доби (48 годин) букет повністю зав'яв. Від магазину додому було 2 хвилини, квіти зразу були поставлені у воду.
Не рекомендую.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Соломія Шумик
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Отримала на подарунок від хлопця квіти з цієї студії.
Квіти вже при доставці виглядали не першої свіжості , їхавши до дому букет випадав з пакування. Писала до них , сказали що усі квіти свіжої доставки. Зараз побачите що сталось з букетом вже зранку. Я шокована 😫 Не рекомендую! Не обманюйте людей, а якщо навіть таке трапилось , вмійте повернути кошти за таке жахіття та зіпсований настрій!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Verbova
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Неймовірно ніжний букет для Соломії та фото квітів з тієї ж партії.

P.S. вдячні всім своїм постійним клієнтам за позитив, який даруєте🌸🌼🌺

user_reviews_extended.Name: Misha Sereda
user_reviews_extended.Description: Чудовий сервіс! Замовлення оформили швидко, доставка вчасна, а квіти — свіжі й красиві. Окреме спасибі привітним дівчатам, які допомогли обрати ідеальний букет. Все на найвищому рівні, рекомендую!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Даниїл
user_reviews_extended.Description: Не перший рік купую тут квіти, завжди гарно підберуть, зберуть і все за дуже адекватні гроші (особливо в цьому районі)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Оксана Ільчук
user_reviews_extended.Description: Дякую за чудове оформлення кафе! Все стильно, зі смаком і до найменших деталей продумано. Атмосфера стала ще затишнішою, а квіти додають особливого шарму. Професійна робота, рекомендую!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Bura
user_reviews_extended.Description: Завжди свіжі квіти та дуже гарні поєднання у букетах. Останній раз квіти від вас у вазі стояли 3 тижні😻

user_reviews_extended.Description: Шикарні квіти придбав для дружини,  шикарне упакування, сервіс, привітність

user_reviews_extended.Name: Валентина Дунай
user_reviews_extended.Description: Брала букет для доньки — усе ідеально! Свіжі квіти, гарне оформлення, чудовий сервіс. Дякую!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Олеся Клеймьонова
user_reviews_extended.Description: Декілька разів давала магазину шанс,але кожного разу квіти ,які вʼянуть на наступний день. Останньою крапкою стали квіти ,які осипалися на порозі магазину. В той час продавщиця сказала,що може ми вдарили квітками об двері…. маразм вищого степеню.Нікому не раджу цей магазин

user_reviews_extended.Name: Iryna
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Подарований букет,зіпсувався одразу на наступний день. Квіти були явно не першої свіжості(
Ціна - якість велика прірва…судячи по відгуках,загальна тенденція. Але винен клієнт,бо не правильно доглядає🤦‍♀️🤷‍♀️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Алла Дунай
user_reviews_extended.Description: Замовляла букет для сестри на день народження, і це було справжнє чарівне диво! Квіти ніжні, свіжі, підібрані з таким смаком, що вразили не тільки іменинницю, а й усіх гостей. Доставка — ідеальна, вчасно, без жодних турбот. Дякую вам за красу та емоції! Тепер я ваш постійний клієнт!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Юра Недзельський
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Оцінка за обман..
А саме , купив готовий букет, зі слів продавця його зробили вчора...
Букет швидко зав'яв( бо йому насправді не 1 день, а мін 6, а то і більше , фото в інстаграм цьому підтвердження, було закинуто 19.01 , купив 24.01 ввечері

user_reviews_extended.Name: Solomiya Pukach
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Квіти, які мені подарували, придбавши у цій крамниці, зів’яли одразу ж наступного ранку. Це дуже неприємно і вперше подаровані квіти в'януть так швидко.
Зразу додам, що стояли вони у великій кількості свіжої води, в прохолодній кімнаті, де немає різкого палючого сонця і достатньо вологи

Також, якщо використовуєте обгорточні матеріали, давайте їх трішки більше. Бо як на мене, їх було дуже вузько і просвічувалися дірки.

Але ключовим в оцінці все ж стали явно не свіжі квіти. Тому не рекомендую.

user_reviews_extended.Name: User123
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Одного разу купував тут букет який дівчинка загорнула в папір(на моє прохання) ,але так не акуратно ,що він весь був як сорочка після прання. Ще й на додачу квіти вмерли наступного ж вечора. Вирішив дати другий шанс,заходив нещодавно і взяв букет піоновидних  троянд,зі слів продавця-свіжих. Троянди опустили голови і посохли через 2 дні. Хочу повідомити ,що квіті тримались в прохолодній кімнаті поруч із зволожовачем повітря.
Не рекомендую нікому і сам туди більше не повернусь.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nataliya Karpyn
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Замовляли букет.Все було супер і свіжість квітів і  підбір квітів.
Рекомедую:)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mcandry Nevidomy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Для мене - найкращий квітковий магазин в цьому районі. Роблять реально гарні букети, а не просто 5 троянд в звичайній обгортці (як в більшості квіткових магазинчиків), квіти довго стоять (тюльпани ось вже 5 день стоять). Рекомендую, поки дуже задоволений.

title: Prime Studio™
address: 315 W 39th St #1101, New York, NY 10018, United States

user_reviews.Name: Robin Tan
user_reviews.Description:
We had the pleasure of collaborating with Prime Studio as an industry partner on several projects to help the end client launch a successful product(s). Throughout our partnership, Prime Studio consistently demonstrated exceptional professionalism and expertise. Their team was highly knowledgeable, responsive, and dedicated to delivering high-quality results.

Prime Studio's innovative approach and attention to detail significantly contributed to the success of our projects. They were always willing to go the extra mile to ensure that our goals were met and that the end client received the best possible outcomes.

We highly recommend Prime Studio to any organization looking for a reliable and skilled partner for branding and product experience. Their commitment to excellence and customer satisfaction is truly commendable.

user_reviews.Name: Joshua Taylor
user_reviews.Description:
Prime Studio is a standout design team that truly understands the complexity and nuances involved in efficient Design for Manufacture. Having worked closely with their team, I'm continually impressed by their ability to create beautiful designs that don't just look great, but are also practical to produce.

What sets Prime Studio apart is their collaborative approach—consistently involving manufacturing feedback early in the design process. As someone who directly oversees the manufacturing phase, I can confidently say their designs consistently translate seamlessly into production, significantly streamlining the manufacturing process.

Additionally, Prime Studio has an exceptional talent for capturing the essence of a brand within their designs, reflecting a depth of understanding that goes beyond aesthetics alone. Their responsiveness, professionalism, and ease of collaboration make them not just talented designers, but reliable partners as well. I highly recommend Prime Studio to anyone seeking thoughtful, brand-aligned, and manufacturing-friendly product designs.

user_reviews.Name: Doug Stukenborg
user_reviews.Description: As co-Founder and former CEO of Welly, I can highly recommend Prime Studio as a product design partner. They worked seemlessly with our team and creative agency partner to ideate, develop options and ultimately decide on our final product and packaging design. They sought to understand our strategy and the essence of the brand in their process. I also appreciated that while we had a point person from their team to support our day-to-day efforts that they always found ways to gather ideas from their broader team to optimize the overall design. Finally, they worked closely with our manufacturing partners to ensure the design went from drawing to a physical product flawlessly. We would not have had the success we had without their partnership and support.

user_reviews.Name: Sean Busch
user_reviews.Description: Stuart and his team are very impressive to work with. We came to them with a concept and very preliminary (Kindergarten-level) drawings. They were able to take that plan and deliver something market ready in a few short meetings. They also helped with the supplier meetings to ensure tolerances, resin mixtures, and other details we had no idea about - were done to the level we were expecting. The end result was a physical product that carried two patents (which they helped with, too) and something truly innovative to an otherwise mature, sleepy category. I was very impressed by how the Prime Studio team worked and wouldn't hesitate to recommend them. In fact, I've referred a few people there way already.

user_reviews.Name: Michael Jankie
user_reviews.Description: Grateful to Stuart and the entire Prime Studios team for the incredible work on our refreshed NATPAT cases. Stuart’s leadership brings together true artistry, technical know-how, and a deep understanding of what moves in market—and the result speaks for itself. The new designs feel like us, but better: more refined, more functional, and more ready to stand out on shelves. It’s rare to find a creative partner who just gets it on every level. Huge thanks to the whole team for going above and beyond—we’re so proud of what we’ve created together.

user_reviews.Name: Anna Rueger
user_reviews.Description: For over 15 years, our family company, Five Star Enterprises, has partnered with Prime Studio to bring brand's product visions to life. Their designs are both logical and production-ready, ensuring a smooth path from concept to manufacturing. We value their attention to detail and collaborative approach.

user_reviews.Name: Melissa S. Gross
user_reviews.Description: Stuart and his team at Prime Studio are fantastic! Thoughtful, thorough, creative, and extremely professional group to work with. I've worked with them on 2 different brand projects, and each time they bring their "A" game and knock it out of the park!

user_reviews.Name: JEFFREY BLIND
user_reviews.Description: What began as a dream partnership with Prime Studio quickly turned into a powerful reality. Not only did they deliver on every promise—they somehow raised the bar. Today, they’re more than just collaborators; they’re a trusted creative force and a proud extension of my brand.

user_reviews.Description: I’ve had a great experience working with 99 Marketing Studio. They’ve taken high-quality images of my products and helped me film content in the highest resolution. user_reviews.Description: We had a fantastic experience working with 99 Marketing Studio for our hair care brand. His calm, professional approach and his team truly has strong creative eye brought out the natural, luxurious essence we aim for. The final photos have significantly enhanced our brand visibility. We’re grateful for the collaboration and look forward to working with 99 Marketing Studio again!

user_reviews.Name: Giancarlo Moretta
user_reviews.Description:
Jordan and his team handled the complete rebranding of my company (Gianni's Fast Food Redefined), including web design and packaging design for our chicken and vegetable burgers.

Saying I'm content with their services would be an understatement—Jordan and his team exceeded my expectations in every way. His ability to truly understand my brand and vision was incredible. He created multiple versions of our logo, fonts, and color schemes that fit exactly what I was looking for.

I've worked with two other design companies in the past, and none of them were able to both grasp my brand identity and implement it into the perfect design the way Jordan did. I highly recommend Leadoff Studio.

user_reviews.Name: Marissa Gelber
user_reviews.Description:
Wow, where to even begin?! Leadoff Studios was truly the perfect partner to help bring Build-A-Brush to life. From the start, they understood our vision and worked closely with us to make it a reality. They weren’t just design partners. They were strategic collaborators who helped guide us every step of the process.

Leadoff Studios was instrumental in every step of the process. We came to them with no experience in design, engineering, or manufacturing, and they guided us through it all with incredible patience and expertise. They supported us with everything from product design to branding to packaging, and even jumped on a late night call with our manufacturer when we needed it.

Their team brought incredible creativity, thoughtfulness, and attention to detail. They asked smart questions, challenged us in the right ways, and always kept the bigger picture in mind.

We’re so grateful for their partnership and couldn’t have asked for a better team to work with.

Thanks to Jordan and the entire Leadoff Studios team, Build-A-Brush looks and feels exactly the way we imagined. We can't wait to work with them again!

user_reviews.Name: Zachary Gelber
user_reviews.Description:
Words cannot even describe the positive experience my startup and I have had working with Leadoff Studios. Jordan and the Leadoff Studio team helped take our children’s toothbrush startup from idea to reality. We were guided through each step of the process with great ideas and opinions.

The team always listened to our vision for our product and company and helped guide us down the path to create exactly we were dreaming of. Their knowledge and experience in the field of industrial design ensured that we never took a wrong step.

We also used their studio for branding and packaging design which was also a very positive experience. The team really listened and executed based on our goals as a start up. We feel they nailed it in every way.

Looking forward to working with Leadoff Studios for future projects!

If you're looking for an industrial design team to help you, then look no further!

user_reviews.Name: Nathan Ghabour
user_reviews.Description: I worked with Leadoff on a custom hardware project for Nike. Their ability to collaborate is at a quality and standard that I show everyone else as example. Jordan's team was able to come in and work under ambiguous needs and clearly find definable and cost efficient solutions for us.  Leadoff masterfully conducted research and presented us with actionable items that lead to us continuing forward with physical production and implementing their designs. would gladly work with them again in a heartbeat.

user_reviews.Name: Rhitu Risal
user_reviews.Description:
Leadoff Studio Team is a super talented, passionate and humble group of creative engineers who really believe in making a positive impact in humanity. It’s been an absolute pleasure working with Jordan, Jess and the Leadoff Studio Team. They helped me create my custom design art makeup palette for my vegan cosmetics brand in 2017. We worked for about two years and have remained connected since then and I definitely hope we work together again in the future!

As a beauty entrepreneur, I have a R&D Lab (R2R Labs) and a vegan brand (R2R Cosmetics) and I was seeking to create a very unique makeup palette for my vegan multipurpose color (hot-pour) formula. With a list full of technical requirements, I wanted to create and design an artistic makeup palette from scratch that was versatile and eco-friendly. Jordan and Jess understood that no was not an answer - they unwaveringly kept thinking outside of the box to bring concepts, designs and solutions for my difficult parameters. They took the time to understand my vision, to meet my needs and to play with my ideas and then they took it above and beyond!

I loved how involved I was with them in the process and I learned so much! They helped me research different types of packaging machines and materials, test them with my makeup formulas, create designs and 3D print them, explore brand designs and color theories to fully being ready for manufacturing with all the technical details perfected. We worked through multiple phases and I always looked forward to their final delivery presentations. Their work is so beautiful and well prepared ahead of time. I truly appreciate how clear they communicated and how well they planned and executed through the different milestones and deliverables. I love how they created a safe collaborative environment - an amazing fun team! Our R2R custom art makeup palette is my most cherished project. I am very grateful for this experience and how it lead me to Leadoff.

user_reviews.Name: Kristie D'Ambrosio-Correll
user_reviews.Description:
I’ve worked with Jordan and Dialto Studio on multiple projects, and every experience has been exceptional. Jordan brings a rare combination of artistic vision, technical skill, and professionalism that’s hard to find. His creative instincts are spot-on — he has an incredible eye for design, and everything he produces feels elevated, thoughtful, and fresh.

What really sets him apart, though, is how easy and enjoyable he is to work with. He’s collaborative, communicative, and genuinely committed to making sure you’re thrilled with the final product. He always delivers on time, and somehow manages to make the whole process feel seamless, even when the scope is complex or the timeline is tight.

If you’re looking for a partner who will not only deliver beautiful, strategic creative work but will also bring a level of care and integrity that’s increasingly rare, Jordan is it. I recommend him without hesitation.

They supported us with everything from product design to branding to packaging, and even jumped on a late night call with our manufacturer when we needed it.

Their team brought incredible creativity, thoughtfulness, and attention to detail. They asked smart questions, challenged us in the right ways, and always kept the bigger picture in mind.

We’re so grateful for their partnership and couldn’t have asked for a better team to work with.

Thanks to Jordan and the entire Leadoff Studios team, Build-A-Brush looks and feels exactly the way we imagined. We can't wait to work with them again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zachary Gelber
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Words cannot even describe the positive experience my startup and I have had working with Leadoff Studios. Jordan and the Leadoff Studio team helped take our children’s toothbrush startup from idea to reality. We were guided through each step of the process with great ideas and opinions.

The team always listened to our vision for our product and company and helped guide us down the path to create exactly we were dreaming of. Their knowledge and experience in the field of industrial design ensured that we never took a wrong step.

We also used their studio for branding and packaging design which was also a very positive experience. The team really listened and executed based on our goals as a start up. We feel they nailed it in every way.

Looking forward to working with Leadoff Studios for future projects!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Colin Neff
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Jordan and his team are stellar! When it comes to product design they are the best in the business. They move quickly and efficiently, and come up with some amazing ideas. They also have the chops to execute it, and know what it takes to make good work.

I've only been lucky enough to work with them once, but I can't wait for another opportunity to collaborate.

If you're looking for an industrial design team to help you, then look no further!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nathan Ghabour
user_reviews_extended.Description: I worked with Leadoff on a custom hardware project for Nike. Their ability to collaborate is at a quality and standard that I show everyone else as example. Jordan's team was able to come in and work under ambiguous needs and clearly find definable and cost efficient solutions for us.  Leadoff masterfully conducted research and presented us with actionable items that lead to us continuing forward with physical production and implementing their designs. would gladly work with them again in a heartbeat.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rhitu Risal
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Leadoff Studio Team is a super talented, passionate and humble group of creative engineers who really believe in making a positive impact in humanity. It’s been an absolute pleasure working with Jordan, Jess and the Leadoff Studio Team. They helped me create my custom design art makeup palette for my vegan cosmetics brand in 2017. We worked for about two years and have remained connected since then and I definitely hope we work together again in the future!

As a beauty entrepreneur, I have a R&D Lab (R2R Labs) and a vegan brand (R2R Cosmetics) and I was seeking to create a very unique makeup palette for my vegan multipurpose color (hot-pour) formula. With a list full of technical requirements, I wanted to create and design an artistic makeup palette from scratch that was versatile and eco-friendly. Jordan and Jess understood that no was not an answer - they unwaveringly kept thinking outside of the box to bring concepts, designs and solutions for my difficult parameters. They took the time to understand my vision, to meet my needs and to play with my ideas and then they took it above and beyond!

I loved how involved I was with them in the process and I learned so much! They helped me research different types of packaging machines and materials, test them with my makeup formulas, create designs and 3D print them, explore brand designs and color theories to fully being ready for manufacturing with all the technical details perfected. We worked through multiple phases and I always looked forward to their final delivery presentations. Their work is so beautiful and well prepared ahead of time. I truly appreciate how clear they communicated and how well they planned and executed through the different milestones and deliverables. I love how they created a safe collaborative environment - an amazing fun team! Our R2R custom art makeup palette is my most cherished project. I am very grateful for this experience and how it lead me to Leadoff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristie D'Ambrosio-Correll
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve worked with Jordan and Dialto Studio on multiple projects, and every experience has been exceptional. Jordan brings a rare combination of artistic vision, technical skill, and professionalism that’s hard to find. His creative instincts are spot-on — he has an incredible eye for design, and everything he produces feels elevated, thoughtful, and fresh.

What really sets him apart, though, is how easy and enjoyable he is to work with. He’s collaborative, communicative, and genuinely committed to making sure you’re thrilled with the final product. He always delivers on time, and somehow manages to make the whole process feel seamless, even when the scope is complex or the timeline is tight.

If you’re looking for a partner who will not only deliver beautiful, strategic creative work but will also bring a level of care and integrity that’s increasingly rare, Jordan is it. I recommend him without hesitation.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dante Paolino
user_reviews_extended.Description: Our small toothbrush company started out as an idea and Leadoff Studio brought that idea to life. Working with Jordan and his team has been such a fun and rewarding experience that I honestly plan on consulting with them as long as our company has a pulse. When we were interviewing different industrial design firms, leadoff stood out amongst the competition as being the most positive, stress free and creative team we came across. Many design firms told us that our idea was going to be too expensive or too complicated focusing on the risks and costs, but Jordan always got us excited about our dream and worked within our budget to make it happen. We also worked with Leadoff Studio on a full branding package which was amazing because of how well their team understood us and our product and their creativity always impressed us. After branding we worked with Leadoff on designing our packaging, picking a manufacturer in China and they then helped us oversee production of our product from prototype to final mass production. We are very excited to launch our product in 2025 and only have great things to say about working with leadoff for the past 2 years. I highly recommend working with them as they are truly a one-stop-shop for product development, they are always positive and they have truly brilliant creative minds. I look forward to more collaboration with them in the future.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Panchenko
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If you want a design crew who jumps in the trench with you and treats your vision like their own, call Leadoff.

I’m insanely picky about who touches my ideas, but these folks won me over in five minutes. They didn’t just nod along—they riffed, sketched, and came back with concepts that were both totally unexpected and totally ‘me’. Every meeting felt like a real creative jam session, not a stiff vendor update. The product’s top-secret for now, but trust me: the work is gorgeous.

If you’re hunting for collaborators who bring big-league creativity and genuine partnership, Leadoff is it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brian Kim
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I started working with Jordan and his team for branding/logo design. They are incredibly talented, have excellent communication, and added value beyond the initial scope, all within budget. They have a comprehensive understanding of brand building and how it ties into logo, marketing, product, website, design, etc. This is woven into their process, comments/questions, and final delivery.

With Leadoff Studios, you are working with a partner that is committed to your vision and success, and I will gladly work with them again!

Thank you Jordan, Mimi, and James!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eben Bitonte
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team at Leadoff Studio was incredibly flexible and immensely creative in helping us to refine our product design; I can only lament that we hadn't started working with them sooner, as their talent, creativity, and processes would have been significantly elevated our initial work. They were so willing and able to dive into highly technical, complex requirements and limitations, and work not just around, but with them, in order to work towards the best version of our product. I'll absolutely come back to Leadoff for future projects!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mandy Yeung
user_reviews_extended.Description: We've really enjoyed working with Jordan and his team at Leadoff Studio - they care a lot about their craft and know what they're doing. Great people who understood our vision and is a joy to work with. We are very happy with the decision to work with Leadoff after interviewing various industrial design firms in the city. Definitely recommend and we look forward to continue working with Leadoff for future projects.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brad Augustine
user_reviews_extended.Description: Jordan and the entire Leadoff Studio team are an exceptional design resource. I've had the pleasure of involving them on multiple projects and have been consistently impressed with the creativity and thoughtfulness of their work. Their designs respected the constraints of the project while pushing the boundaries of inspiration. Final designs are elegant and refined which is a reflection of their overall expertise. Highly recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Bolinger
user_reviews_extended.Description: Kindness, creativity, ingenuity, grit, proactive problem-solving, excellent communication -- Leadoff truly has it all. This team is a fountain of great ideas all while staying flexible and accommodating to shifting needs and priorities of the project. I truly can't wait for the next opportunity to work with Jordan, Anna, and the rest of the Leadoff team. If you get the chance to work with them yourself, don't miss it!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sabina Gal
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had the pleasure of working with Jordan and his team on multiple projects, and every time, they’ve delivered exceptional results. Their talent and creativity are unmatched, and they consistently go above and beyond—navigating tight deadlines and troubleshooting any challenge with ease. They will always be my top choice for any design project!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alicia D
user_reviews_extended.Description: It’s rare to find a team that both balances and excels in customer service, talent, and vision and Leadoff is among those select few. I’ve  been working with their team for four years on a hardware device and they have guided us through multiple iterations of our product design, and somehow managing to best themselves each time. It’s so refreshing to work with a team who can take both your obscure & vague ideas or minute & nitpicky directions and execute on them flawlessly and flexibly. Not only are they great at what they do, but they are also great people who are enjoyable to work with. I highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Louis
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Jordan and Leadoff Studio are the most incredibly talented people you could ever work with. If you have an idea you need to bring to life, there is no better group of people you could work with. They provided me with all the information about costs and steps in the life cycle of developing my product and went above and beyond by linking me with exceptional graphic designers, mechanical engineers and manufactures to bring my idea and brand to life. They have treated me with incredible respect and made me feel comfortable to share feedback, making the product development process collaborative and fun.

Their results could almost lead you to believe they are a massive global firm but it’s their meticulous attention to detail and personal approach to design that highlights their boutique-feel. Last but not least (and arguably most importantly), they make beautiful things! If you choose them to design your product, concept, invention, whatever, you are going to be blown away with what they do.

Best decision I ever made was to call them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Molly Snyder
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an incredible experience working with Jordan and his team at Leadoff. They really helped us refine our product and worked with us in a collaborative way. Additionally, they are very knowledgeable on the process of creating a product form end to end, and they gave us a great understanding of all that manufacturing entails. I would highly recommend Leadoff Studio!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robin Tan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Leadoff's team understand the impact not just on the designing portion but the entire supply chain process. This is extremely helpful where we can start the conversation very early on with our factory engineers to rule out potential issues down the road. This type of knowledge puts our operation team ahead of the game to prevent delay and over budget. Sounds easy but very difficult to execute from design to manufacturing.

We have several other projects that are in the process with Leadoff and our team can't be any happier to have established this long term relationship with Leadoff. This review and recommendation is not just from me personally but the entire team at Zenpack.us. Thank you Leadoff Studio!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennie Fan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an incredible experience working with Jordan and his team. Leadoff studios offered us a custom-designed technical sketching workshop, tailored for mechanical engineers without previous sketching experience. The class was well-paced, challenging, and offered us new skills we can now practice within our day-to-day. Highly recommend and appreciate the team's adaptability to our needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Louis
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Jordan and his team at Leadoff Studio are sincerely the most incredibly talented people you could ever work with.  If you have an idea or concept you need to bring to life, there can be no better group of people that you could work with to do so.   They quite literally lifted the image of my invention from my mind’s eye and put it to paper.  They even elevated the concept to a place I could only dream of.  You can tell that for this team of people, industrial design is a passion and not just a job.

Their results and experience could almost lead you to believe they are a massive, global firm but it’s their meticulous attention to detail and remarkably personal approach to design that highlights their boutique-feel.  Last but not least (and arguably most importantly), they make BEAUTIFUL things.  If you choose them to design your product, concept, invention, whatever - you are going to be BLOWN AWAY with what they do.

Whatever idea you have in your head, you can trust the people at Leadoff Studio to make it real.  They will work fast and keep you within a realistic budget to bring your idea to fruition.  They are super talented, super smart, genuinely care about diversity and consider environmental impacts in their design renderings.   They make stuff gorgeous.   And they can provide you with everything you need throughout the entire product design and development cycle to accomplish your goal.

Best decision I ever made was to call them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sam Dixon
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team at LeadOff was great to work with. They were super professional, came up with tons of creative solutions to our design issues, and always flexible based on our needs. Would certainly recommend them. Shout out to Jordan and Clotilde!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicholas Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been working with Leadoff for a couple months now on an industrial design project for my brand. Exceeded all my expectations and really brought my creative ideas to life. They are so passionate in what they do and I can tell by my deliverables that they really spent time and effort in creating all my concepts. Needless to say, I will be back for future projects!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tiare
user_reviews_extended.Description: I worked with Leadoff Studio on designing hardware equipment for a CV AI/ML project at a fortune 100 company. The team was very attentive to our needs and delivered a functional and successful product that enabled us to drive the overall project forward. We appreciate the relentless effort over the two years working together.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Tosti
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have had the pleasure of working with Leadoff Studio on two highly complex products with quick moving timelines.  My first experience was when myself and my co-founder hired Leadoff to partner with us on the design of a pet tech IOT enclosure.  Most recently, as a Product lead at a Fortune 100 company, I once again partnered with Leadoff to drive the design for a mobile capture unit for a CV AI/ML project.

In both instances Leadoff studio went above and beyond to deliver a robust, thoughtful and beautiful product on schedule (even ahead of schedule!). You can depend on Leadoff for clear communication, intentional and clever design solutions, attention to detail, and in general just great collaboration. I highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ciarán Murphy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've worked with Jordan and Leadoff on a couple projects at this point, and I'm looking forward to many more. They're a responsive group, capable of dealing with weird requests at odd hours. Their designs are unique, elegant, and easy to manufacture. After completing the scope of the projects, they've always gone above and beyond during the rest of the product development process to make sure that the spirit of the design shows through any manufacturing based challenges. Can't recommend them enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashlee Posner
user_reviews_extended.Description: We couldn't have had a better experience working with a design team. Leadoff Studio Team is a insightful, passionate and far exceed expectations on projects they believe in. I greatly appreciate all of the hard work and time they put in to our design.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angelo Stracquatanio
user_reviews_extended.Description: We've worked with Leadoff for over 3 years now and I can't say enough positive things about working with them.  We're an emerging tech company and through working with Leadoff we've brought multiple product visions to market.  Each of those products have greatly exceeded our expectations and have been well received by our customers.  Leadoff spent the time to deeply understand our domain (life sciences) and our tech (augmented reality) and used that knowledge to build a product that delivered on the rough 'idea' that we had.  They pulled it completely from concept to product and delivered it on time.  I think the whole team there is exceptional and would recommend them to anyone who is looking for a strong partner to bring their ideas to life. -Angelo, CEO & Co-Founder, Apprentice.io

user_reviews_extended.Name: Castle Flexx
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve watched my celebrity clients launch products every year but Leadoff took my brands to another level with designing products that started out as an idea or a big reach. The team was meticulous, thoughtful, and most of all eco conscious in their designs which is important to me. After designing my product they also designed and produced my packaging which was just as challenging based on my standards. They knocked it out of the park in two completely different categories, a medical grade case and a fitness brand for pro athletes.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anthony Browne
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I came to Leadoff with a rough prototype of my folding cart invention. Their industrial design team transformed it into a pitch-ready product. They solved the technical problems I couldn't, added ergonomic features, and gave it a sense of style.

The process was easy for a first timer. They walked me through it from concept review, trend research, and sketches to 3D CAD and renderings. Then they helped get the new version fabricated and photographed. For my next product, I'll call them in sooner.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Collin Lafayette
user_reviews_extended.Description: Leadoff studios is so much more than just a design studio. I worked with Jess and Jordan on products for Ro (formerly Roman) where they built concepts from a blank piece of paper through the international logistics required to land them on a tight time line. You will never find a better group to work with or more complete, thoughtful, and powerful products and designs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teagan Morrison
user_reviews_extended.Description: Jordan & team at Leadoff are fantastic. Their process was so thorough, they enthusiastically ideated iterated and prototytped, they were knowledgable of manufacturing techniques, and the final results speak to all these things. Great team making great products. Would highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bill Dixon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Jordan and his team, especially Clotilde, were eminently professional.  I showed up with aspirational designs but left out the parts of how it would actually work.  I then shifted the goal posts half a dozen times, while sending them demanding late night emails. They redid prototypes and bore up under my increasingly confused and shifting objectives in a professional and structured way, ultimately getting me to a working product.  I cant recommend them enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dan Castle
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve watched my celebrity clients launch products every year but Lead Off took my brands to another level with engineering of products that started out as only an idea or a big reach. In one scenario I knew what I wanted and they executed perfectly. In another scenario I had no idea and they came up with the ideas for me and then I chose. In both cases the team was meticulous and thoughtful and most of all, eco conscious in their designs which is important to me. After designing my product they also designed and produced my packaging which was just as challenging based on my standards. They knocked it out of the park in two completely different categories- PPE mask case and a fitness brand for pro athletes.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexandra Fine
user_reviews_extended.Description: We have worked with Leadoff Studios over the past 5 years and have continued to be impressed by their work. They not only come up with beautiful designs but are thoughtful about how design will meet manufacturing. I highly recommend them.

title: Unbox Product Design
address: 364 11th St, San Francisco, CA 94103, United States
plus_code: QHCP+9P SoMa, San Francisco, CA, USA

user_reviews.Name: Rena Heegaard
user_reviews.Description:
We had the great opportunity to get to know and partner with Andrew Bowen from Unbox Product Development. Our partnership began in 2020 with the initial concept, design, development, manufacturing, sourcing, and launch of our first product, Potty Pillow. We worked with Andrew and his team through the entire process of bringing this product to life, and I am absolutely thrilled to share my experience working with him. From the first time we met to the delivery of our first manufacturing run and everything in between, their expertise, creativity, innovative approach, professionalism, and dedication far exceeded our expectations.

What sets Unbox apart is its unmatched proficiency in combining creativity with practicality. They didn't just create a product; they created an experience that resonated with our customers and one that’s revolutionizing the way people experience comfort in the bathroom today. Unbox’s attention to detail was evident throughout the process, from the sleek and elegant design and the premium materials sourced to addressing the hygiene factor of the product. It was clear that they were committed to the success of our brand.

If you're looking for a partner who will not only exceed your expectations but walk with you through your journey, I wholeheartedly recommend Andrew Bowen and the Unbox Product Development team. Partnering with Andrew has been the best business decision we’ve made, and we would not have been at this stage of our business without him. Andrew has been a pivotal part of our business, and we look forward to our continued partnership.

user_reviews.Name: Jason Litner
user_reviews.Description: I can't say enough to recommend Andrew Bowen and his design team at Unbox. Unbox has been our exclusive design and development partner for a complicated, multi-year hardware project after having started the project elsewhere. Andrew is not only an exceptionally talented and creative designer, but also an extremely effective project manager. He has competently and efficiently steered us through the design for manufacturing process and met each occasional and inevitable hardware hiccup with solutions that are both ingenious and cost-effective. The team at Unbox just will not stop until they have the solution you need! With Unbox, you get the personal touch and attention to detail of a small team with the capabilities and know how of a larger firm. These include deep contacts with overseas manufacturing, part sourcing, prototyping and oversight of various engineering disciplines. Our project required specialized knowledge in fluidics, electrical engineering, and firmware development, among others- all managed by the team at Unbox. What I admire most about Unbox is how personally involved they are- Andrew and his team treat your baby like their own and are incredible stewards of your finances. If you are looking to launch an elegantly-designed product on time and on budget, I can think of no one better than the Unbox team to help bring your product to life. Feel free to contact me with any questions.

user_reviews.Name: Forti Goods
user_reviews.Description:
Working with Speck Design put our company out of business.

After an extensive nationwide search, I accepted their proposal in Fall 2022 for what was scoped as a 10-week project. They presented confidently and seemed qualified. The first red flag came immediately: they skipped the opening milestone entirely — a bench top system outlined in their own scope of work — and surprised us instead with a custom board design, demonstrating it over a call as operational. It wasn’t ready.

What followed was more than 8 board revisions over 2.5 years. The project specifications never changed from what we provided before kickoff. They strung us along for years, never acknowledging that their chip selection could never meet our battery life requirements — a fundamental flaw they should have caught at the outset. Then, while supposedly debugging the battery life issue, they ghosted us. No response to calls or emails for over a year.

We paid them nearly six figures. We spent another 50% on top of that debugging and integrating their work ourselves. Despite their recommendation to increase our battery size by 4.5x, the device still cannot run on battery alone. The project remains incomplete and unusable. Our early customers are angry, and we have little recourse.

user_reviews.Name: Alex Joseph
user_reviews.Description: collaborating with Speck Design has been a game-changer for our project. Their innovative approach, combined with a deep understanding of our needs, led to a product that exceeded all expectations. From the initial concept to the final design, Speck Design's team demonstrated exceptional creativity, technical skill, and a genuine passion for excellence. Their commitment to our vision made them not just a service provider but a valued partner in our success. The finished product stands as a testament to their talents, and we couldn't be more pleased with the results. I highly recommend Speck Design to anyone looking for top-tier design and engineering solutions.

user_reviews.Name: Kevin Tamura
user_reviews.Description: I started engaging with Spec Design in Fall 2024, and they were great to work with. They took the time to really understand my requirements and approached the relationship like true partners. I appreciated that they did not try to over-direct the process or impose their own thinking over what I actually needed. They listened well, communicated clearly, and adapted as priorities evolved, which made the whole experience feel collaborative and productive. They brought thoughtful input and strong expertise, but always in a way that stayed aligned with my vision and goals. I would absolutely recommend them.

Then, while supposedly debugging the battery life issue, they ghosted us. No response to calls or emails for over a year.

We paid them nearly six figures. We spent another 50% on top of that debugging and integrating their work ourselves. Despite their recommendation to increase our battery size by 4.5x, the device still cannot run on battery alone. The project remains incomplete and unusable. Our early customers are angry, and we have little recourse.

user_reviews.Name: Victoria
user_reviews.Description:
Дякуємо команді студії GL Design за відмінно виконану роботу з розробки дизайну та консалтингу на стадії імплементації проекту. Дуже приємне враження склали клієнтоорієнтованість команди, професійний підхід та увага до деталей котрі допомогли вибудувати список вимог про які ми навіть не задумувались. Тепер трішки конкретики:

- Терміни створення дизайну – все було чітко зроблено в узгоджені терміни. (Нажаль завдяки забудовнику нам довелось чекати ще майже пів року до початку робіт)

- Якість виконання креслень – з сторони майстрів котрі виконують роботи не було нарікань та уточюючих запитань, з нашої сторони маючи в руках креслення можна було легко перевірити чи робота була зроблена правильно

- Підхід до підбору матеріалів – ризик який ми вважали найстрашнішим(оскільки найбільше переживання було що матеріали з дизайну та креслень могли бути відсутні в продажі або коштувати «космічних» грошей) – тут команда відмінно відпрацювала, частина матеріалів(зокрема плитка) була підібрана з існуючих колекцій перед розробкою дизайну приміщень.

- Дизайн VS Справжній проект – враховуючи що проект на стадії завершення ремонтних робіт можна сказати що ми всі(студія дизайну, майстри та замовники) впорались на 97.86%(це суб’єктивна оцінка, оскільки досить складно придумати спосіб виміряти такий показник). Звісно що це перевершило усі наші очікування

- Клієнтоорієнтованість – тут робота команди була відмінною. Враховуючи що ми вирішили імплементувати проект власними силами і більшість наших звернень буди після завершення офіційної співпраці з командою -  кожного разу Як Петро(керівник студії), так і Юля – архітектор, котра займалась розробкою нашого проекту максимально нам допомагали та надавали вичерпну інформацію відносно будь якого питання. Яскравим прикладом був підбір фарб – враховуючи що є досить багато виробників фарб з різними палітрами, ми попросили надати список кольорів фарб з палітри одного з іноземних виробників. Список ми отримали протягом кількох годин.

- Супровід проекту – це помилка якої ми допустились коли почали робити проект відмовившись від супроводу. Маючи дизайн та креслення немає жодної складності втілити проект в життя, АЛЕ КОНТРОЛЬ ВИКОНАННЯ РОБІТ КРАЩЕ ВІДДАТИ ПРОФЕСІЙНІЙ КОМАНДІ, а місяці збереженого часу приділити близьким людям.

З своєї сторони рекомендуємо команду студії GL Design як команду професіоналів здатних робити нетривіальні проекти та готових до складних викликів(навіть майстри в одній з ситуацій тримаючи в руках креслення не могли повірити що таку річ можливо зробити)

Команді професіоналів студії GL Design бажаємо побільше цікавих та нестандартних проектів.

user_reviews.Name: Monica Ressino
user_reviews.Description:
From process to presentation these guys are true professionals.  The attention to detail was a relief as I had no stress at all and everything came out exactly to specification.

Carole was a dream to work with.  I highly recommend using this agency and Carole as project manager if you can get her.   Sick a delight to work with true pros!!!!

user_reviews.Name: Alberto Farronato
user_reviews.Description: I've collaborated with Gallery Studio Design across multiple projects, and their team consistently impresses with their blend of creativity and design skills. From collateral to animated videos, GDS has been instrumental to get our message across and to make our brand to stand out, significantly boosting our marketing efforts. They are not just a service provider, but a true thought partner. I highly recommend Gallery Studio Design for anyone looking to elevate their company's branding.

user_reviews.Name: Orit Hershlikevitch
user_reviews.Description:
I'm super happy to work with GDS!  The team really gets our vision and brings it to life with amazing creativity and precision. They’re professional, detail-oriented, and genuinely dedicated to delivering high-quality results. Their commitment to our projects has made them a true partner in our success.

If you need a partner who not only delivers incredible work but is also great to work with, GDS is the way to go. Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: David LaCombe
user_reviews.Description: As a small business founder, I depend on Galley Design Studio to transform my ideas and messaging into content that resonates with my customers. I trust the staff at GDS and enjoy working with them. They make the design process frictionless and the products we create together are always on target.

user_reviews.Name: Richard Clements
user_reviews.Description: I have had the pleasure of working with GDS as a Marketing leader at a couple of companies. Their team understands the importance of creativity and strategic thinking when it comes to branding. They are very collaborative and have produced presentations, collateral, video and other assets that have helped me promote my companies. They’re a thought partner as well. I would highly recommend GDS.

user_reviews.Name: Daniela Sarti
user_reviews.Description: I have worked with GDS on & off over last 4 years.  What truly sets them apart is how invested they are in the success of a project. They doesn’t just deliver a service; they operate as a true extension of the team, sharing the same goals and dedication. I’m not particularly proud of the fact that I put undue stress on them by delaying feedback on our end whilst up against a tight deadline, but they stepped up in a way that few could.

user_reviews.Name: Angela Santillo
user_reviews.Description: GDS has been a long-time collaborator and they have supported our creative team with everything from animations to eBooks to event booths to social graphics and more. I highly recommend Caroline and her team. They are super responsive, create great work, and have played a big role in some of our most successful marketing projects.

user_reviews.Name: Caroline Ohmes
user_reviews.Description: Gallery Design Studios has been very helpful for our company. They think outside the box and have helped us with everything from daily social content to a complete design rebrand. They work hard to understand our company and our products in order to make content that represents us well.  They are easy and flexible to work with and respond to our requests & needs quickly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Srijani Kirti
user_reviews_extended.Description: Having worked with Gallery Design Studio on branding, web design and user interface design projects, I can say that they provide consistently sleek, modern and bold designs with attention to detail that is hard to find. They take the time to ask questions and really learn about your  objectives before starting the design process, cutting down on revisions and providing excellent value for your dollar. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Chasanoff
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience collaborating with Gallery Design Studio to design an infographic for our nonprofit organization. The concept of our infographic was quite complex in nature and the team at Gallery Design Studio was able to work with us through several iterations to come up with a compelling and dynamic deliverable that broke down the concept into something easy to understand for our readers! Would highlight recommend Caroline and her team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carol Mason
user_reviews_extended.Description: Gallery Design executed my brief perfectly and painlessly. It was an iterative process, carried out responsively, efficiently and on time. I now have a beautiful, memorable report template for my new product, thanks to Caroline and her team. We'll be putting more work their way and I recommend them wholeheartedly :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: V Bispo
user_reviews_extended.Description: GDS team did a great job with my infographics and brochures. The team provided reliable, on-schedule materials with a passionate and honest attitude! My number #1 pick for anything graphic design and brand related!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Kollias
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience. 12 page deck, no photos just custom infographics, waypoints, etc. We had several revisions due to changing circumstances and they were accommodating and fair. Always on schedule and stayed within our budget. I will be using them again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natasha Cambell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Really enjoy working with the team on a diverse range of design projects from social media assets, infographics to whitepapers and sales enablement materials. They're a fun and creative bunch who 'get' the brief and are always responsive, on time and on budget.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Malena Diz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love collaborating with GDS for branding my work. Provides me with great business cards, look-books, and clear consultation.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Larry Gladstone
user_reviews_extended.Description: Carloline Peterson of Gallery Design was very professional and helpful and designed some very creative business cards for me. I would highy recommend Carline and Gallery Design....

user_reviews_extended.Name: Clayton Banks
user_reviews_extended.Description: Gallery Design is efficient, creative and very professional. Its great to have an agency on demand.

user_reviews.Name: Sofiia Romanyk
user_reviews.Description:
Отриманий результат повністю відповідав нашим очікуванням, чудова якість матеріалів та акуратність виконання.
Окрема подяка менеджеру Каті 🤍
Катя була завжди на зв’язку, уважна до деталей, оперативно відповідала на всі запитання та допомагала знайти найкращі рішення. Спілкування було максимально комфортним і професійним і це зробило весь процес легким і приємним)

user_reviews.Name: Ilona Bekish
user_reviews.Description:
Дякуємо Студії дизайну та реклами «BRANDME за професійну співпрацю у виготовленні сувенірної продукції для наших працівників.
Ми отримали якісну підтримку на всіх етапах - від комерційної пропозиції та підготовки презентації до коректного оформлення документів відповідно до чинного законодавства.
Замовлення виконано в обумовлені терміни, а продукція повністю відповідає очікуванням: матеріали якісні, нанесення логотипу виконане акуратно та естетично.
Окрема подяка менеджеру Катерині Грущак за уважність, оперативність та персоналізований підхід.

user_reviews.Name: Уляна Сорока
user_reviews.Description:
"Вони прекрасні!" - перша думка, коли побачила флісовий реглан, який замовляла наша компанія з нашим лого.
Приємне спілкування, оперативні відповіді й уважність до деталей. Співпрацювалось легко та без зайвих клопотів — саме такою і має бути якісна комунікація.

user_reviews.Name: Ірина Сілецька
user_reviews.Description:
Дуже крутий і професійний підхід до роботи.
Асортимент справді великий, тож вибір був непростий - але з цим нам дуже допомогли.

З нами працювала менеджерка Оксана: відповідала на всі запитання, знімала відеоогляди та супроводжувала нас на кожному етапі. Комунікація була максимально комфортною і зрозумілою.

У результаті все вийшло просто бомбезно - і за якістю, і за виконанням.

Звертаємось уже другий рік поспіль і точно будемо приходити ще! Рекомендувала цього підрядника вже не одним знайомим)

user_reviews_extended.Description:
BrandMe - це острівець спокою та стабільності у світі обмежених бюджетів, стислих дедлайнів і "треба на вчора").
Комунікація швидка і конструктивна, товари якісні, доставка оперативна.
Просто щаслива працювати разом ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nadiia Saraieva
user_reviews_extended.Description: BRANDME - це про дуже якісну продукцію, теплу, приємну комунікацію і швидке виконання замовлень, коли термін "на зараз". Я вже двічі робила замовлення саме у BRANDME - стікери, стікерпаки і листівочки. Дуже задоволена і впевнена, ще буду звертатись в майбутньому саме сюди. Їх команда реалізовує всі нетипові запити, працює з техніками, які далеко не всі роблять у Львові і як каже менеджерка Надія Вергелес - "Можемо все в межах можливого")). Дуже дякую за це :) Просто скарб!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Valery Nudel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Чуйна та турботлива комунікація, якість і стиль продукції та емоції, які залишаються, коли користуєшся мерчем від BRANDME - створюють відчуття, що хочеться повернутись з наступними замовленнями. Командо, дякую вам за те, що ви створюєте!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Брендмі, ви неймовірні ❤️

Коли потрібно зробити мерч до події - навіть не роздумуємо, звертаємося тільки до вас.
Завжди все чітко, швидко й з душею. Дякуємо, що на вас можна покластися 🙌

user_reviews_extended.Name: Орина Горєлова
user_reviews_extended.Description: Третій рік готуємо корпоративний мерч з brandme. Завжди гарна якість готової продукції, швидка та чітка комунікація. Задоволена співпрацею і точно повернусь до вас ще!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Tyschuk
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Розробили, погодили, і виготовили 10 худді за два дні. Завжди все робим завчасно, але цього разу час піджимав.
Однозначно за оперативність пʼятірочка!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Svitlana Mykhajlyshyn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Замовляємо мерч в BrandMe не вперше і радіємо тому:) Подобаються товари і якість друку на них. Також дуже цінна уважність менеджерок/ів та дотримання дедлайнів (зазвичай BrandMe віддають все ще швидше, аніж обіцяли))))

user_reviews_extended.Name: Viktoria Shevliuk
user_reviews_extended.Description: Сервіс на вищому рівні - команда завжди робить усе швидко та якісно. Уже тривалий час користуюся послугами, і кожного разу задоволена на усі 100%🙌

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nadia Lekchniuk
user_reviews_extended.Description: Неймовірно задоволена співпрацею з BRAND.ME! Менеджер Надія Вергелес стійко витримала всі наші численні корективи і переузгодження обсягу замовлення, завжди була на зв'язку та дуже оперативно реагувала на всі запити. Ми мали доволі велике і дуже різнопланове замовлення з дууууже вузькими термінами і все було зроблено просто ідеально й з запасом вчасно! Ми замовляли футболки, блокноти, ручки, олівці, павербанки, шопери, бейджі, шнурки для них і сертифікати - все вищої якості, друк яскравий та насичений, оперативна доставка. Однозначно замовлятиму тут знову!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Юлия Куц
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Хочу щиро подякувати команді BRANDME (особливо менеджеру Тетяні:-))) за професіоналізм, відповідальність і чудовий результат! Замовляли брендовану продукцію для корпоративних заходів— усе було виконано бездоганно: якісно, стильно, з увагою до деталей.

Особливо хочу відзначити:
* швидкість виготовлення та дотримання термінів,

* якісний друк і матеріали,

* гнучкий підхід до наших побажань,

* приємну й комфортну комунікацію на кожному етапі.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sun Energy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Не вперше працюємо з BRANDME, а саме з менеджером Тетяною. Задоволені на всі 100%! Дякую за Вашу роботу!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Анна Маркетолог
user_reviews_extended.Description: Щиро дякуємо команді BRANDME за професіоналізм а також за те, що зробили замовлення якісно і супершвидко! Приємна комунікація, індивідуальний підхід, якісні матеріали, класні продукти, чудовий посмак нашої з Вами співпраці! Будемо звертатись ще:)

user_reviews_extended.Description: Дуже гарна комунікація і швидке виконання замовлення. Замовила худі , вишивка якісна і гарно виглядає. Дякую!

Особливо дякую менеджеру Марії!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Олексій Сідей
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Замовляли у агенції BrandMe худіки, ручки та блокноти для своїх співробітників.

Всі товарі відмінною якості: худіки зручні та з гарного матеріалу, вишите лого яскравого кольору та високої якості; ручки пишуть гарно і не розмазують; блокноти мʼякі і приємні на дотик. 🙏

Менеджери допомогли з макетами, надали професійну консультацію, як краще зробити. Всю продукцію отримали у вказані строки. 🤝

Одназно можу рекомендувати цю агенцію для придбання сувенірною продукції високої якості за адекватні гроші 🔥

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vadym Shumeiko
user_reviews_extended.Description: Будучи тісно пов'язаний з внутрішнім маркетингом, дуже часто  замовляю корпоративний мерч. І з впевненістю можу констатувати, що краще за BrandMe на ринку наразі нікого немає ❤️‍🔥 Дизайн, брендування, процес замовлення, оплата - все завжди швидко і просто. Окрема подяка менеджеркині Тетяні, працювати з якою одне задоволення!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kalerija Filina
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Замовляли у студії блокноти – сервіс найвищого рівня!
Окрема подяка менеджеру Каті за оперативність та залученість у вирішенні всіх складних моментів.
Справжній професіонал своєї справи  Рекомендуємо!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marina R
user_reviews_extended.Description: Добрий день. Хотіла вам надати фідбек по худі, які нам виготовляли до корпоративного свята. Всім дуже сподобалось. Якісні матеріали, вишивка, класний колір, ви постарались на 100% і всі це оцінили. Відчувалось, що в руках тримаєш якісну річ, а не дешевий мерч. Думаю як стане прохолодніше люди будуть носити із задоволенням. Я сама приміряла з цікавості - дуже стильно виглядало і комфортно. А найголовніше, дякую за чіткість по термінам і що нічого не наплутали з розмірами, це особисто від мене, бо переживала а раптом щось не так порахували і комусь не той розмір дістанеться ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Володимир Стрілець
user_reviews_extended.Description: Замовляв об'ємні наліпки. Обслуговування та спілкування з клієнтом на високому рівні.  Результатом замовлення задоволений. Особлива подяка за співпрацю менеджеру Ярині.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katia Yefimchuk
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Компанії змінюються, але Brand me залишається незмінним partner in crime:) Закрила дуже багато проєктів з їхньою допомогою, один з найбільших -- SoftServe Roadshow, на який студія виготовляла брендовану продукцію для 10 івентів, на понад 300 учасників кожен у дуже обмежені строки. Дуже приємні в комунікації, гнучкі, і мерч якісний.

Я безліч разів писала менеджерці, коли горіли усі строки і виробництво будь-чого здавалось нереальним, але кожного разу все вдавалось. Це не робить мене найкращою клієнткою, але Brand me точно афігезний і надійний стейкхолдер:)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ira Melnyk
user_reviews_extended.Description: Бренд мі дуже крута студія. Виручили нас і терміново виконали замовлення. Вдячні за високу якість і оперативність)

user_reviews_extended.Description: Дуже приємні враження від співпраці з менеджером Катериною. Дуже вдячна їй за ввічливість, оперативність і найоптимальніші рішення в короткі строки. Розраховую на довгу та продуктивну спільну співпрацю!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Дуже професійний підхід в роботі, якісна комунікація та відмінний результат в розробці пакування та брендбука загалом🙂

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Замовляли у компанії BranME кружки та футболки, і хочемо подякувати за такий якісний і красивий мерч! 😍

В мене зазвичай специфічні потреби, адже хочеться чогось неординарного, а не всі це можуть реалізувати.
Вперше попавши в цю компанію мені з 10 запитів на рекламні агенства сказали що це неможливо :) - в Brandme зробили!
Після цього менеджери мабуть мене зненавиділи за мої вимоги , однак на виході я отримав саме те що хотів, дуже круто і «смачно» зробили.
По термокружках все було значно простіше, адже логотип вже був готовий, я думав що чекатиму на них десь 2 тижні, але мені їх зробили ну дуже швидко, точно не пригадаю, здається 3 дні, що теж мене дуже порадувало.
Загалом я є проблемним клієнтом для багатьох і дівчатка з брендмі зробили все, щоб я був повністю задоволений.
Тому з повною впевненістю я рекомендую цю компанію всім друзям.
Ті хто прочитав цей відгук до кінця - повірте, ви будете задоволені співпрацею з цією крутою командою!
Бажаю вам успіхів та побільше крутих клієнтів!

Теперь многим своим клиентам, приходящим ко мне на массаж, советую создавать на Google maps свою точку услуг или продаж и воспользоваться услугами компании Люкс Сайт.

I’ve been trying to reach this agency for over two weeks! Multiple emails and phone calls, but no response at all. As a business actively seeking a marketing partner, I expected at least some acknowledgment or follow-up. Unfortunately, the lack of communication raises concerns about reliability and professionalism. I’m disappointed, especially considering the positive reviews that influenced my decision to contact them in the first place.

My response to their reply:
Thank you for your reply. I understand that you are a boutique agency, but that does not excuse two weeks of silence across multiple channels (contact forms, emails, and phone calls)

After your reply to this review, I made another effort to reach out by both phone and email. Unfortunately, your phone system still says no one is available, and I have not received any reply to my follow up email, not even an automated acknowledgment.

The fact that I received a quick response here, but not through direct channels, suggests that monitoring Google reviews takes priority over actual client communication. That is concerning for any potential partner.

Lastly, accusing someone of leaving a fake review based solely on the name used on Google is unnecessary. Many people use partial names online for privacy. That kind of assumption came across as defensive and unprofessional, especially given that I was making a legitimate inquiry.

I was genuinely interested in working with your agency, but the continued lack of response and the tone of your reply have only confirmed my concerns. I hope this feedback encourages improvements in how inquiries are handled moving forward.

Their detailed oriented and experience team has made a the world of a difference in both how we rank organically and strategically target retarget visitors.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan Clancy
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I engaged Jives Media after a three-month search for a suitable Google Ads agency, initially attracted by their promises of expertise and a tailored approach. Unfortunately, our experience was extremely disappointing, and the results did not reflect the $4,700 per month we invested in their services.

From the start, there were significant issues with their approach and recommendations. One of our key concerns was the suggestion to change our main campaign’s bid strategy from Target Impression Share to Maximise Conversions without conducting an A/B test. As someone experienced in Google Ads, I know that changing a bid strategy is one of the most significant shifts you can make within a campaign, and it should never be done without proper testing. Jay described this change as "baby steps," but the suggestion revealed a clear disconnect in understanding and a concerning lack of expertise from the team.

Adding to this, the team recommended pausing bids for the search term “eyelash extension course,” which is literally the core product we sell. This recommendation was not only baffling but showed an evident lack of understanding of our business and goals. We had expected a partner with a sound strategy aligned with our business needs, but these suggestions showed the opposite.

Our concerns were repeatedly ignored or mishandled, leading to a further breakdown of trust. I specifically requested to speak directly with Jay, the CEO, to address these strategy concerns and discuss his team’s experience with accounts of our scale. Instead, Jay brought additional team members, preventing an open discussion about these issues. The lack of regard for our requests as a new client left us feeling undervalued and sidelined.

Further adding to the frustration, Jives Media regularly took days to respond to our emails, even as a new client. In an industry where timing and communication are critical, this lack of responsiveness only deepened our dissatisfaction.

On the technical side, Jives Media was contractually responsible for conducting market analysis and competitive research during their onboarding process. Instead, we were asked to provide our own list of competitors and revenue data, which they could have easily accessed within our Google Ads account. This failure to carry out basic responsibilities reinforced our view that they were not doing the necessary work to manage our account effectively.

Additionally, when it came to landing page optimisations, I had made it very clear that 90% of our traffic came from mobile users. Despite this, we received recommendations based solely on desktop performance. This oversight showed a clear lack of attention to detail and was another instance of them not fully comprehending or accommodating our business needs.

After expressing our dissatisfaction and intent to part ways, we were met with legal involvement from their team. I had hoped for an open conversation directly with Jay, business owner to business owner, to resolve matters amicably, but instead, I received an email from their billing department with legal threats. This approach was both unexpected and disappointing, especially after I had clearly stated in writing that we did not intend to share our experience publicly.

In short, Jives Media’s strategy, responsiveness, and lack of attention to detail did not reflect the professional service they promoted during initial discussions. For $4,700 a month, we expected a knowledgeable, proactive partner, yet the reality fell far short of that standard. Businesses looking for a Google Ads partner should proceed with caution, as our experience highlighted serious issues with both their strategy and client service.
